column1: # Everyday Sindhi words that should win over Wikipedia's formal words when
# a typed spelling fits both (e.g. haal -> حال, not هال). One word per line,
# optional TAB + a Roman spelling: typing exactly that spelling gives this
# word first (useful for loanwords like table -> ٽيبل).
# Seeded with the maintainer's WhatsApp-style examples (2026-11-11).
